id./param/scenario/cs/b_120_cs_110.pack|cs_: "Oh, {var:1}! Thank you for coming.
"Last night I had another dream. I saw Veronica here.
"This is Luminary's Landing. They say it's where the Luminary landed from the sky after fighting the Dark One.
"In the dream, Veronica stood here playing this flute.
"This is the flute the sage Serenica left in Arboria after slaying the Dark One.
"I gave it to Veronica as a charm, but when I woke this morning, it was on my bedside.
"Perhaps this flute will show us the way. Serena, play it.
"Yes, then...
"Nothing happens...
"But if Veronica played it in the dream, it surely means something. {var:1}, please keep it.
"This light...!?
What! Veronica's flute turned into a fishing rod!
"The flute...!
"The flute seems to have become a fishing rod... Absurd, am I dreaming?
"Eek! A bite! {var:1}, pull!

{var:1} pulled the rod with all his might!
...Then something huge appeared from the clouds!
"A flying... fish... No, is that... a whale?
"Oh... the myth was true. That's what I saw in my dream...
"The divine vessel, Cetacea...!!
"The legend lives again. If you play that flute, the divine messenger will carry {var:1} into the sky.
{var:1} received the Calamus flute!
